children: ("Braemar", "the Company" and together with its subsidiaries the "Group")
Strong revenue growth and strategic investment in the platform
On track to deliver in line with full year expectations1
, a leading provider of expert chartering, investment and risk management advice to the shipping and energy markets, announces a trading update for the six months ended 31 August 2026 ("HY27").
Revenue up 16% to £74.3m (HY26: £63.9m), driven by a strong rate environment;
Underlying operating profit2 up 7% to £6.0m (HY26: £5.6m), after making £1.4m of strategic investments to drive future growth;
Net debt reduced to zero as at 31 August 2026 (HY26: £5.6m); and
Strong forward order book3 of $73.4m (FY26: $72.5m and HY26: $73.8m).

The board remains confident that the Group will deliver in line with market expectations for the full year. Increased volatility across shipping and energy markets has lifted average rates in our chartering business and underpins strong demand for our advisory and risk management services. We expect the strategic investments made in the first half, including senior hires and the establishment of our power desk, to convert to profitable growth in the second half.
The Company expects to announce its results for HY27 by mid-November 2026.
Commenting, Grant Foley, Group CEO said:

“I am delighted with the performance of the business in the first half. We have made deliberate investment in our platform and people during the period as we continue to execute our strategy to build a £200m revenue business by FY30. Our balance sheet has strengthened further and trading remains in line with market expectations for the year. The quality of the team we are building and the progress made in the first half gives me confidence in what the second half will deliver.”

Company compiled consensus prior to the release of this announcement for the year ended 28 February 2027: revenue £139.5m (£138.0m - £141.7m); underlying operating profit (before acquisition-related expenditure) £14.2m
The total forward order book covers commissions that will be earned in future periods up until 2039
Grant Foley, Group Chief Executive Officer
Richard Heading, Group Chief Financial Officer
Kate Hoare / Charlie Barker / Polly Clarke

Braemar provides expert advice in shipping chartering, investment and risk management to enable its clients to secure sustainable returns and mitigate risk in the volatile world of shipping. Our experienced brokers work in tandem with specialist professionals to form teams tailored to our customers' needs, and provide an integrated service supported by a collaborative culture.
Braemar joined the Official List of the London Stock Exchange in November 1997 and trades under the symbol BMS.
For more information, including our investor presentation, visit www.braemar.com and follow Braemar on LinkedIn.
